items.regioselectivity: low, nucleophilic attack possible at both C1 and C2
items.stereoselectivity: The reaction is stereoselective, producing the trans isomer of hexahydrobenzo[d]oxazol-2(3H)-one (trans-HBC) via SN2 attack, resulting in inversion at one carbon center. The product has an enantiomeric excess (ee) of 53%.
